title: Clamp Score
description: Write a function `clamp_score(score, min_val=0, max_val=100)` that restricts a numerical score so it never falls below `min_val` and never exceeds `max_val`.

hidden_tests.kind: a score exactly on the minimum threshold
a score exactly on the maximum threshold
a score comfortably inside the range

hints: Clamping requires setting boundary walls while leaving values within the interval unchanged.
Inspect how boundary scores (equal to min_val or max_val) are handled by your conditions.
Make sure your logic doesn't invert the bounds or drop values that are exactly on the edge.
Compare if score < min_val: return min_val; if score > max_val: return max_val; otherwise return score.
